summary: Payoneer Global Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on September 8, 2026, updating stockholders on a pending take-private-style merger with Canada-incorporated Neon Maple Parent Inc. (Nuvei), dated June 12, 2026, under which Merger Sub merges into Payoneer, leaving Payoneer a wholly owned Nuvei subsidiary. A special meeting is set for September 14, 2026, for holders of record as of August 6, 2026. Two New York suits (filed August 20-21) seek to enjoin the deal over alleged proxy omissions; demand letters followed. Watch disclosure-driven delays and vote outcome.
